title: Choose seek-versus-skip using validated container boundaries
finding: The local metadata probe walks checked box lengths with box/read budgets, handles safe extended top-level sizes and fails closed to deep inspection. Source reads are bounded. R045's source-map latency regression remains relevant; no new remote seek-versus-skip threshold is measured.
novelty: R045 owns source-bound access decisions; this screen does not reopen R003's failed whole-player cost gate.
next_action: Keep bounded local metadata skipping. Reopen remote policy only with a measured Range-capable transport workload and stale-hint, malformed-size and ignored-Range controls; include index acquisition cost.
reopen_condition: Do not reopen R003’s stopped profile without a changed mechanism/source. If normal inspection already reads only useful ranges, keep adverse tests instead.

proposal_contract.Proposed mechanism: Use known box lengths or verified metadata hints to avoid scanning irrelevant payload; decide whether to skip or reopen a range using measured source costs, not a copied constant.
proposal_contract.Smallest useful experiment: Compare front/tail moov, large free boxes, stale hints, 64-bit sizes, zero-sized/truncated boxes, a server ignoring Range and local Blob input.
proposal_contract.Correctness gate: Identical parsed metadata and selected sample offsets; no out-of-bounds read or unbounded retry; stale identity rejected; ignored Range responses handled explicitly.
proposal_contract.Measure only after correctness: Requests, fetched bytes and startup delay including request overhead; no expected gain percentage.
